text: Hans Bohn (December 23, 1891 – May 10, 1980) was a German graphic artist and typographer. He developed the fonts Orplid, Mondial, Allegro, and the heavier weight of Kuenstler Script. After training at the Technische Lehranstalt in Offenbach, he began his professional career at the Ullstein Verlag in Berlin in 1914. From 1919 to 1930, he worked at the Klingspor Foundry. Afterwards, he became a freelance graphic designer. In the 1930s, he produced fonts and graphic arts for Ludwig & Mayer, a major German foundry. In the 1950s, he produced the Kuenstler font for the Stempel foundry. Kuenstler Font is available at Adobe. This biographical article about a graphic designer is a stub.
